question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**in**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "the sinking of the passenger-and-car ferry Estonia (1) ____ the Baltic" requires a preposition that indicates location or area where the sinking happened.
 
• "In the Baltic" is the correct collocation because it refers to the ferry sinking within the Baltic Sea.
 
• Other options such as "on the Baltic," "over the Baltic," and "up the Baltic" do not correctly describe the location in this maritime context.
 
• "On" typically refers to surfaces (e.g., "on the lake") but is less appropriate for naming seas; "over" implies movement above something; "up" implies direction, none of which fit the sentence meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

**Complete Passage: ***Naval architects never claim that a ship is unsinkable, but the sinking of the passenger-and-car ferry Estonia **in__** the Baltic surely (2) ______ never have happened. It was well designed and (3) ______ maintained. It carried the proper number of lifeboats. It (4)______ thoroughly inspected on the day of its fatal voyage. Yet hours later, the Estonia rolled over and (5) _______ in a cold and stormy night.*
